subject: Brightbridge renewal: evidence package due & CRM stage update
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@brightbridge.com>, procurement@brightbridge.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightbridge renewal: evidence package due & CRM stage update

Hi Anna / Procurement team —

Quick reminder as we head into quarter close: we need the renewal evidence package (SOC2 summary, latest usage report, and billing contact confirmation) by EOD Thursday so FinOps can finalize the renewal paperwork and our finance team can validate ARR for the quarter. Items we specifically need: 

- Signed PO or confirmation of intent (if available)
- Latest monthly usage snapshot (CSV or report) — last 6 months preferred
- Billing contact + updated billing email (procurement@ is fine)
- Any contract change requests (scope, seats, data retention)

Can Naomi & Karthik confirm whether we should move the HubSpot stage to "Commit - Evidence Requested" once we receive the package? If Brightbridge sends partial docs, list what’s outstanding and we’ll accept incremental uploads.

Attachment: brightbridge-evidence-package.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai

From: Anna Lopez <anna@brightbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Brightbridge renewal: evidence package due & CRM stage update

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can get most of that over by Thursday. A couple quick notes so we deliver exactly what you need: 

- Usage snapshot: do you want aggregate tokens (or API calls) vs per-team details? We have both.
- Billing contact: reconfirming that procurement@brightbridge.com is the correct address for invoices going forward.
- PO: finance is routing the PO; we should have a signed copy by next week, but I can share the PO number for interim tracking.

We will upload the CSV and a short cover note to the Drive link you provided. If anything is missing, please flag what we should prioritize.

Anna Lopez
Head of Platform Ops, Brightbridge Inc
anna@brightbridge.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna@brightbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightbridge renewal: evidence package due & CRM stage update

Thanks Anna — that plan works. A few operational asks from finance before we mark stage: 

1) ARR confirmation: we need a one-line confirmation of committed ARR for the upcoming term (can be the PO number + value or a signed commitment).
2) Invoice history: please attach the last paid invoice (PDF) and a CSV of invoice totals for 2024-2028 (we attached a template: invoice-history-2024-2028.csv).
3) Usage breakdown: aggregate monthly usage (tokens or calls) is fine. If you can include the two highest-usage teams, call them out; that helps our capacity planning.

Karthik — can you update HubSpot to "Commit - Evidence Requested" once Anna uploads the Drive folder and we confirm ARR line? We want CRM to reflect that Finance has everything it needs to issue final terms.

If any of these items will slip past Thursday, tell us what will be late and why so we can decide whether to proceed with a conditional commit.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@brightbridge.com>, procurement@brightbridge.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Brightbridge renewal: evidence package due & CRM stage update

Anna — appreciate the quick turnaround.

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 9:07 AM Anna Lopez <anna@brightbridge.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sergio —
> 
> We can get most of that over by Thursday. A couple quick notes so we deliver exactly what you need: 
> 
> - Usage snapshot: do you want aggregate tokens (or API calls) vs per-team details? We have both.
> - Billing contact: reconfirming that procurement@brightbridge.com is the correct address for invoices going forward.

We will accept the aggregate usage snapshot plus a callout of the top two teams (token counts OK). Procurement address confirmed. If you can include the invoice PDF and the ARR line (PO or commitment), Naomi can finalize the numbers today. Once uploaded, Karthik will flip the HubSpot stage and add the Drive link to the deal record.

If it helps, Naomi and I can do a 15-min sync today at 11:30 PT to confirm the ARR line and any billing nuances — would you be available?

Next steps: 
- Anna: upload usage CSV + invoice PDF to the Drive link by EOD Thursday (or flag which items will be later).
- Naomi: review ARR line and advise if we can move to commit.
- Karthik: update HubSpot stage and paste Drive link into deal record (link above).

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
